configuration.offlinesqlquery: /*CTEStart*/WITH __QuickFind__ as (select [businessprocessflowinstanceid] from (/*QuickFindStart*/ SELECT "expiredprocess0".[businessprocessflowinstanceid] AS [businessprocessflowinstanceid] FROM [ExpiredProcess] AS "expiredprocess0"   where ("expiredprocess0".[name] like {0}) OR ("expiredprocess0".[knowledgearticleid!name] like {0}) OR ("expiredprocess0".[activestageid!name] like {0}) LIMIT 10001/*QuickFindEnd*/) as [__QuickFindInternal__])/*CTEEnd*//*SelectStart*/select  "expiredprocess0".[businessprocessflowinstanceid] as "businessprocessflowinstanceid" , "expiredprocess0".[name] as "name" , "expiredprocess0".[createdon] as "createdon" , "expiredprocess0".[knowledgearticleid!id] as "knowledgearticleid!id" , "expiredprocess0".[knowledgearticleid!logicalname] as "knowledgearticleid!logicalname" , "expiredprocess0".[knowledgearticleid!name] as "knowledgearticleid!name" , "expiredprocess0".[activestageid!id] as "activestageid!id" , "expiredprocess0".[activestageid!logicalname] as "activestageid!logicalname" , "expiredprocess0".[activestageid!name] as "activestageid!name" , "expiredprocess0".[statecode] as "statecode" , "expiredprocess0".[statuscode] as "statuscode" , "expiredprocess0".[processid!id] as "processid!id" , "expiredprocess0".[processid!logicalname] as "processid!logicalname" , "expiredprocess0".[processid!name] as "processid!name"/*SelectEnd*/  /*FromStart*/from  ExpiredProcess as "expiredprocess0"/*FromEnd*/  /*WhereStart*/where  [expiredprocess0].[businessprocessflowinstanceid] in (select [businessprocessflowinstanceid] from [__QuickFind__]) and (("expiredprocess0".[statecode] = 0))/*WhereEnd*/  /*OrderByStart*/order by  "expiredprocess0".[knowledgearticleid!id] asc/*OrderByEnd*/
